answer: After Queen Victoria (the first monarch to reside there) left following the death of her husband in 1861, the palace was seldom used, neglected, and shuttered for most of the year; in 1864, a note appeared on its fence suggesting it be let or sold due to the "declining business" of the occupant, until public pressure eventually forced her to return to London.
